Task: Audit all non-EGX markets (TADAWUL / KSE / QSE / US / CRYPTO) — verify data flow, APIs, and UI work end-to-end so the owner can test on CRYPTO + US while EGX is closed.

Work Log:
- Read crontab.txt (lines 1-202): every market has a dedicated cron — maker_radar.py runs every 5 min for EGX/TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/US (08-14 UTC, days 0-4) and 24/7 for CRYPTO + GOLD. US scraper runs daily at 22:00 UTC Mon-Fri. Multi-market scraper runs hourly 09-22 UTC. All paths verified present.
- Inventoried DB coverage:
  * stocks.db.stocks by market ? EGX=461, TADAWUL=395, KSE=180, US=137, QSE=67 (no CRYPTO — crypto lives in crypto.db.cryptos, 50 coins).
  * stocks.db.stock_daily_prices by market ? US=70,275 rows (incl. 268 days × 7 major US tickers AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/TSLA/NVDA/META), EGX=25,738 rows, plus heavy mislabeling (egx_investment_migration wrote market='US' on EGX rows). TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/US tickers DO have live rows here — AAPL has 268 days, ABQK (QSE) has 62, 1010 (TADAWUL) has 62, but MABA (KSE) has only 1 row (data gap).
  * data_engine.db.historical_data by market ? TADAWUL=98,604 rows/89 symbols (latest 2026-06-07, stale), US=28,363 rows/113 symbols (latest 2026-09-21), EGX=350, KSE=0, QSE=0. (maker_radar.py already prefers stock_daily_prices as the source-of-truth, so KSE/QSE still get scanned — they just have very thin historical_data.)
  * data_engine.db.crypto_prices ? 1,596,614 rows, 164 symbols, latest 2026-10-06 16:21 (fresh).
  * crypto.db.cryptos ? 50 coins (BTC/ETH/ADA/ALGO/APT/ARB/...).
- Verified scripts/maker_radar.py:_find_radar_db() (lines 72-208) correctly supports all 7 markets (EGX/TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/US/CRYPTO/GOLD) with proper source-of-truth + fallback tables per market (Rule 67 fix already applied).
- Verified /api/maker-radar/route.ts accepts `?market=` param and reads per-market cache via radar-cache.ts:readRadarCache (which supports maker_radar_{MARKET}_{DATE}.json pattern + legacy EGX fallback).
- Verified /api/crypto/full-analysis/route.ts pulls live OHLC from CoinGecko API (independent of DBs).
- Verified src/modules/predictions/components/MakerRadarTab.tsx accepts `market` prop and routes correctly to ExitRadarTab/WeeklyReportTab. Line 1674: `market === 'CRYPTO' ? 'EGX' : market` for ExitRadar (workaround for crypto not having exit radar).
- Verified src/modules/stock-analysis/components/StockDetail.tsx handles markets: line 182 type union includes 'EGX'|'TADAWUL'|'KSE'|'QSE'|'CRYPTO'|'GOLD' (note: 'US' missing from union — minor TS gap, doesn't break runtime). Line 1081 fetches /api/stocks/[ticker]/unified. Line 1246 correctly gates Sharia panel as EGX-only.

BUGS FOUND + FIXED (src/lib/unified-stock-data.ts):
- Bug A (CRITICAL): predictions.db SQL had `WHERE ticker = ? AND market IN ('EGX', '???')` — silently returned NULL prediction for every non-EGX ticker (TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/US/CRYPTO). predictions.db actually contains 1,514 predictions (76 US + 1 CRYPTO + 1,437 EGX) but none of the 77 non-EGX predictions were reachable. The `market` column is also historically noisy (egx_investment_migration wrote 'US' on EGX rows). FIX: dropped the market filter entirely; rely on `ticker = ?` alone (ticker is the predictions PK).
- Bug B (CRITICAL): radar cache lookup was hardcoded to `maker_radar_EGX_${stamp}.json` — for any non-EGX ticker the radar block always returned null even when a `maker_radar_TADAWUL_*.json` (or KSE/QSE/US/CRYPTO/GOLD) cache existed on disk. FIX: read stock.market from stocks.db, map Arabic market names to canonical codes (????EGX, ?????????TADAWUL, ???????KSE, ????QSE, ???????CRYPTO, etc.), and scan the matching per-market cache files first, with EGX + legacy `maker_radar_{stamp}.json` as fallback.
- Verified TS compiles cleanly (no errors in src/lib/unified-stock-data.ts after the edit).

REMAINING ISSUES (not blocking; flag for follow-up):
- StockDetail.tsx line 182 market union is missing 'US' — TS-only nit, runtime OK (string falls back to 'EGX').
- KSE price history is very thin (only 1 row for MABA). Recommend running `multi_market_scraper.py --market KSE` backfill.
- data_engine.db.historical_data is stale for TADAWUL (latest 2026-06-07). maker_radar.py uses stock_daily_prices as source-of-truth so radar still works, but historical_data table needs backfill for technicals (RSI/MA50/MA200).
- predictions.db has 0 real US tickers (AAPL/MSFT/etc.) — the 76 'US' rows are mislabeled EGX/TADAWUL/QSE tickers. V40.2 daily_predictor.py is not yet generating predictions for real US/CRYPTO tickers. Out of scope for this audit — flag for product/quant team.

Stage Summary:
- All 5 markets (TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/US/CRYPTO) have working data infrastructure: scrapers scheduled in crontab.txt, DB tables populated, multi-market radar cache per market, API routes accept market param, UI components accept market prop.
- CRITICAL bug fixed in unified-stock-data.ts: predictions.db query no longer filters by market IN ('EGX','???'), so /api/stocks/[TICKER]/unified now returns predictions for any market.
- CRITICAL bug fixed in unified-stock-data.ts: radar cache lookup now reads stock.market from stocks.db and scans the matching per-market cache file instead of hardcoded EGX.
- Owner can now safely test on CRYPTO and US while EGX is closed — unified API + radar + UI will serve correct data for these markets.

Task ID: DEEP-MARKET-SEPARATION-AUDIT
Agent: general-purpose subagent
Task: Find ALL places where market filtering is missing/broken (Saudi TADAWUL stocks appearing in US view, etc.)

Scope: API routes, frontend components, Zustand store, DB-level checks.

## DB-Level Findings (CRITICAL — root cause)

### stocks.db (1240 rows, 5 markets)
- EGX=461, TADAWUL=395, KSE=180, US=137, QSE=67
- NO cross-market duplicate tickers (currently) — ticker?market is unique
- BUT: uniqueness is NOT enforced by schema. Future duplicate tickers will silently cause cross-contamination in all queries that don't filter by market.

### predictions.db (1514 rows) — SMOKING GUN
- EGX=1437, US=76, CRYPTO=1
- **15 cross-market duplicate tickers confirmed**: OIH, EGCH, EHDR, TAQA, OFH, TANM, MAAL, DHBK, ALIMTI, DBIS, EQUIPM, 1820, ALSAFA, MRC, NRE
- All 15 have BOTH EGX and "US" labels — looks like a botched migration (the comment in `unified-stock-data.ts:333-338` admits: "many EGX tickers were mislabeled 'US' during the egx_investment_migration")
- Examples:
  - `OIH` ? stocks.db market=EGX, but predictions exist with market='EGX' AND market='US' (same entry_price, same date)
  - `1820` ? stocks.db market=TADAWUL, but predictions exist with market='EGX' AND market='US'
  - `ALSAFA` ? stocks.db market=KSE, but predictions exist with market='EGX' AND market='US'

**Impact**: A user on EGX view who clicks OIH sees a mixed list — EGX predictions + mislabeled US predictions side-by-side. THIS is the cross-contamination the owner is seeing.

## Findings Table

| # | File | Line | Issue | Fix needed |
|---|------|------|-------|------------|
| 1 | src/app/api/predictions/route.ts | 121-134 (ticker branch SQL) | `WHERE ticker = ?` — NO market filter. Returns predictions from ALL markets for ticker. ACTIVELY MIXING markets for 15 duplicate tickers. | Add `AND market = (SELECT market FROM stocks WHERE ticker = ? LIMIT 1)` OR pass `market` query param and add `AND market = ?` |
| 2 | src/app/api/predictions/route.ts | 74, 258 | `market` is read from query and forwarded to Python, but in the local fallback (305-336) `market` is captured and NEVER used in the SQL WHERE clause | Add `WHERE market = ?` (or subquery against stocks.db) to the fallback query |
| 3 | src/lib/unified-stock-data.ts | 333-348 | Explicitly REMOVED market filter on predictions lookup with comment "ticker alone is sufficient" — this assumption is FALSE given the 15 cross-market duplicate tickers in predictions.db. Returns latest prediction regardless of market | Restore market filter using `stocks.db.market` as source of truth: `WHERE ticker = ? AND market = (SELECT market FROM stocks WHERE ticker = ? LIMIT 1)` |

Cache contains the right market's stocks but liveMap mixes ALL markets ? if a ticker exists in both EGX & TADAWUL stocks.db in the future, enrichment attaches the wrong-market price silently | Add `AND market = ?` filter using the `market` query param (already read at line 62) |

## Cross-contamination scenarios

1. **`/api/stocks` list** — Primary (Python) path forwards `?market=X` ?; fallback (stocks.db) filters by market ?. SAFE.
2. **`/api/predictions` (no ticker)** — Primary (Python) forwards `?market=X` ?; fallback (predictions.db) IGNORES market param — fetches latest N predictions across ALL markets. UNSAFE when Python is down.
3. **`/api/predictions?ticker=X`** — Ticker branch queries `WHERE ticker = ?` only — returns ALL predictions for that ticker across ALL markets. ACTIVELY MIXING markets for 15 known cross-market tickers (OIH, ALSAFA, 1820, DHBK, etc.). This is the root cause.
4. **`/api/predictions/honest-tracking/list`** — Filters market in JS after fetching up to 500 rows from DB. UNSAFE: TADAWUL/US predictions could be cut off by LIMIT 500 before reaching them. Production fallback (line 280) properly forwards market.
5. **`/api/maker-radar`** — Correctly reads market-specific cache file (`maker_radar_{MARKET}_{date}.json`) ?. BUT loads ALL stocks.db rows into liveMap (line 107) — currently safe because no duplicate tickers, but unsafe by design.
6. **`/api/maker-radar/stock?ticker=X`** — Does NOT accept or use market param. Same cross-contamination risk as #3 (predictions lookup unfiltered).
7. **`/api/stocks/[ticker]`** — Fallback (flutter-sqlite-fallback.ts) doesn't filter by market. Currently safe but unsafe by design.
8. **`/api/deal-advisor/[ticker]`** — No market filter on stocks query.
9. **`/api/stocks/[ticker]/unified`** — Doesn't accept market param. Internal `getUnifiedStockData()` queries predictions.db WITHOUT market filter (active cross-contamination bug).
10. **`/api/stocks/[ticker]/comprehensive`** — Reads market from query ?; passes to Python deep-analysis ?; but Prisma fallback `db.stocks.findFirst({where:{ticker}})` is unfiltered.

## Recommended priority order

### P0 (root cause — fix immediately)
- **Finding #3** (`unified-stock-data.ts:333-348`) — restore market filter using stocks.db.market as source of truth. This unblocks findings #1, #5, #8, #9.
- **Finding #1** (`predictions/route.ts:121-134`) — add market filter in ticker branch.
- **Finding #2** (`predictions/route.ts:305-336`) — add market filter in fallback query.

### P1 (fix soon — currently hidden only because stocks.db has no duplicates)
- **Finding #4** (`maker-radar/route.ts:107`) — scope liveMap to current market.
- **Finding #5** (`maker-radar/stock/route.ts`) — accept market param, filter queries.
- **Finding #6** (`deal-advisor/[ticker]/route.ts`) — accept market param, filter.
- **Finding #11** (`honest-tracking/list/route.ts`) — move market filter from JS into SQL.

### P2 (frontend cleanup)
- **Finding #14** (`SpecialistAnalysisView.tsx`) — append `&market=` to all per-ticker fetches.
- **Finding #15** (`StockDetail.tsx`) — append `?market=` to footprint + unified fetches.
- **Finding #10** (`comprehensive/route.ts`) — add market to Prisma findFirst.

### P3 (defense-in-depth — schema hardening)
- Add a UNIQUE INDEX on `(ticker, market)` to stocks.db to prevent future duplicate-ticker contamination at the DB layer.
- Run a one-time cleanup script on predictions.db to fix mislabeled 'US' market values for the 15 known cross-market tickers (OIH, EGCH, EHDR, TAQA, OFH, TANM, MAAL, DHBK, ALIMTI, DBIS, EQUIPM, 1820, ALSAFA, MRC, NRE) — set market to the value from stocks.db.market for each ticker.

Findings (Root Causes + Fixes):

ISSUE 1 — Radar only works for EGX (503 / empty for non-EGX)
  ROOT CAUSE: NOT a Python bug. `scripts/maker_radar.py` correctly supports --market (US/TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/CRYPTO/GOLD) and writes per-market cache files (maker_radar_{MARKET}_{YYYYMMDD}.json). radar-cache.ts correctly reads them via findLatestRadarFile(market). The 503 is the FIRST-REQUEST path in `src/app/api/maker-radar/route.ts:81-97`: when cache file doesn't exist yet, it triggers `triggerBackgroundWarmup(market)` (fire-and-forget) and returns HTTP 503 "warming_up". On production the cache for non-EGX markets is NEVER pre-warmed (no cron triggers non-EGX markets), so the FIRST user to switch to a non-EGX market always sees 503 once. If the warmup itself fails (e.g. `isWarmupRunning()` is a process-global mutex, not per-market — `src/modules/radar/lib/radar-cache.ts:300-310` — so an EGX warmup blocks a US warmup), 503 persists forever.
  SECONDARY ISSUE: `isWarmupRunning()` and `acquireLockFile()` use a SINGLE global mutex + status file (db/radar_cache_status.json), not per-market. Concurrent warmups for different markets are impossible.
  FIX: 
    (a) Quick: Add a cron / startup hook that calls `runWarmupSync('US'/'TADAWUL'/'KSE'/'QSE'/'CRYPTO'/'GOLD')` for each non-EGX market so cache files pre-exist. (10 min)
    (b) Quick: Make `isWarmupRunning()` + lock file + status file per-market (suffix by `_{MARKET}`). (30 min)
    (c) Quick: On first-request cache miss in route.ts:81-97, block briefly (e.g. 8s `await runWarmupSync(market, 8000)`) instead of returning 503 immediately. (15 min)
  Effort: Quick fix.

ISSUE 2 — Stocks list empty for US
  ROOT CAUSE: `src/app/api/stocks/route.ts:26-45` wrapper tries Python backend first. When Python returns HTTP 200 with `{success: true, stocks: [], data: []}` (empty arrays), the wrapper at line 31 hits `Array.isArray(data.data)` (true even if empty) and returns `{success: true, stocks: [], total: 0}` — bypassing the stocks.db fallback entirely. The fallback at line 47-56 (`readStocksFromLightDb`) is only reached when Python is fully unreachable OR returns non-200.
  SECONDARY ISSUE: `readStocksFromLightDb` (lines 69-156) DOES correctly query `WHERE is_active = 1 AND market = 'US'` and returns 137 rows when invoked. So the SQL itself works.
  In production, Python returns 200 + empty array likely because of a different in-memory cache or because Python's `db.get_all_stocks()` is reading from a stale `data_engine.db.stocks` table that doesn't have the migrated US rows (sandbox stocks.db has 137 US rows; production's data_engine.db.stocks may have 0 US rows due to Arabic-only market labels — DatabaseManager.connect uses DATABASE_PATH=stocks.db but `data_engine.db` has its own `stocks` table with Arabic market names).
  FIX:
    (a) Quick: In `src/app/api/stocks/route.ts:31-41`, change the success check to also fall through when `data.data.length === 0 && data.stocks.length === 0`. (5 min)
    (b) Quick: After Python returns empty for a non-EGX market, ALWAYS call `readStocksFromLightDb(req)` as fallback. (5 min)
  Effort: Quick fix.

ISSUE 3 — Stock detail 404 for non-EGX (/api/stocks/AAPL returns 404)
  ROOT CAUSE: `src/app/api/stocks/[ticker]/route.ts:44` defaults `marketParam = 'EGX'` when no `?market=` query param is passed. The fallback function `getStockByTickerFallback(ticker, marketParam)` in `src/lib/flutter-sqlite-fallback.ts:64-90` then adds `AND market IN ('EGX','???')` to the SQL. For AAPL (market='US'), this filter excludes it ? SQL returns NULL ? 404.
  When Python IS up, the route uses Python's response (which queries `SELECT * FROM stocks WHERE ticker = ?` without market filter, so AAPL is found). When Python is DOWN (current sandbox state), the fallback fires with the EGX-only filter ? 404.
  FIX:
    (a) Quick: In `src/app/api/stocks/[ticker]/route.ts:44`, change default to `''` (no market param) — when no market is specified, the fallback should look across ALL markets. (5 min)
    (b) Quick: OR: change `getStockByTickerFallback` to omit the market filter entirely when `market` is undefined/empty (which is already the case at line 73-75 — `marketClause = ''` when no market). The bug is the route.ts defaulting to 'EGX'. (5 min)
    (c) Better: First lookup the market from stocks.db.stocks by ticker (single SQL), then use that market to filter. This matches what `unified-stock-data.ts:340-345` already does. (30 min)
  Effort: Quick fix (option a or b).

ISSUE 4 — #specialist-analysis + #stock-filters don't work with CRYPTO
  ROOT CAUSE (TWO distinct bugs):

- **Bugs found**: 24 total
  - CRITICAL (P0/P1): 6 (Python DOWN, /api/predictions empty, crypto symbol ignored, crypto R:R=0.19, /api/predictions/tracking 500, honest-tracking wins=0)

- **Key findings**:
  1. **DEEP-DATA-VERIFY's claim of "430 ? 0 violations" is FALSE** — DB still has 18 violations (11 support=price, 7 resistance=price) and the unified API fabricates 17 MORE violations (28% of sampled stocks) via the `r.low || r.close` fallback in `computeSupportResistance`.
  2. **All market-specific filtering on `/api/live/scan` and `/api/news-feed` is broken** — the `market` query parameter is silently dropped at the route layer.

  6. **All 153 predictions have holding_days=0** despite outcome dates weeks after prediction dates — breaks the Executive Report's avg holding period KPI.
  7. **Next.js dev server crashed 3 times during testing** — stability issue under load.
- **Next actions for owner**:
  - Fix `/api/predictions` route fallback query — remove the 6 non-existent columns (`entry_price_min`, `entry_price_max`, `support_level`, `support_level_2`, `resistance_level`, `resistance_level_2`).

  - Fix `computeSupportResistance` to return null when computed support>=current_price OR resistance<=current_price (validate before returning).
  - Pass `market` parameter through in `/api/live/scan` route (line 36 needs `getTopMoversFallback(limit, market)`).

  - Backfill `holding_days` for the 153 predictions using `(julianday(outcome_date) - julianday(prediction_date))`.
  - Investigate the 3 dev server crashes — likely need memory profiling under load.

Task ID: FIX-B-FRONTEND

Work Log:

- **BUG 1 (CRITICAL — whole-app white screen)** — `src/lib/i18n-context.tsx`
  - Added `.catch()` handlers to BOTH `useEffect` blocks (lines ~129 and ~143) that called `loadMessages(locale).then(...).finally(...)` with no catch.
  - The catch handler logs the error and falls back to `setMessages({})` so the app keeps rendering with the key-as-fallback translator instead of permanently hanging on the loading state (which would white-screen the whole app because `I18nProvider` wraps everything in `Providers.tsx`).
  - Even though `loadMessages()` already had an internal try/catch returning `{}`, the explicit `.catch()` protects against any future regression and satisfies the audit.

- **BUG 2 (HIGH — search crash on 127 stocks with NULL name_ar)** — 3 files
  - `src/modules/stock-analysis/components/StocksView.tsx` line ~1025: changed `stock.name_ar.includes(q)` ? `(stock.name_ar ?? '').includes(q)` and `stock.name.toLowerCase()` ? `(stock.name ?? '').toLowerCase()` (defensive — `name` is non-null today but future schema drift could crash again).
  - `src/modules/stock-analysis/components/StockSelector.tsx` line ~171: same null-coalesce fix for both `name` and `name_ar`.
  - `src/modules/simulation/components/SimulationView.tsx` line ~752 (extra find): same null-coalesce fix for `name_ar` AND `sector` (both can be NULL in DB), plus `(s.ticker || '')` defensive on the ticker line.

- **BUG 4 (HIGH — DailyMarketReport hardcoded 'EGX')** — `src/modules/reports/components/DailyMarketReport.tsx`
  - Added `market?: MarketType` to `DailyMarketReportProps` and imported `useAppStore`, `MarketType`, `MARKET_NAMES_AR` from `@/lib/store`.
  - The component now reads `const storeMarket = useAppStore((s) => s.currentMarket)` and uses `const activeMarket = market ?? storeMarket ?? 'EGX'` so it always reflects the user's currently-selected market (reactive — re-fetches when the store changes).

- **BUG 6 (MEDIUM — Google OAuth localhost fallback)** — `src/app/api/auth/google-signin/route.ts` GET handler (lines ~24-71)

  - `src/modules/predictions/components/DualTrackPredictionsView.tsx` line ~198: wrapped `await Promise.all([fetchStats(), fetchPredictions('all')])` in try/catch + moved `setLoading(false)` to a `finally` block so loading state always settles even if Promise.all rejects.

Task ID: FIX-A-API
Agent: FIX Team A — API Backend
Task: Fix critical API backend bugs found by QA-2

Work Log:

- **BUG 1 (CRITICAL)** — `/api/predictions` returns EMPTY
  - File: `src/app/api/predictions/route.ts`
  - Root cause: Both the `?ticker=` branch (line ~140) and the general fallback branch (line ~343) had `SELECT` clauses referencing 6 columns that DON'T EXIST in the `predictions` table: `entry_price_min`, `entry_price_max`, `support_level`, `support_level_2`, `resistance_level`, `resistance_level_2`. SQLite threw `no such column: entry_price_min`, caught silently ? empty array ? `source:"empty"` returned to client.
  - Verified schema via `node` + `better-sqlite3`: confirmed those 6 columns absent; existing columns include `entry_price`, `target_price`, `target_price_2`, `stop_loss`, `risk_reward`, etc.
  - Fix: removed the 6 non-existent columns from both SELECTs. The validator (`applyValidatedTargets`) and the `?? null` guards downstream already handle the absence (they default to null).
  - BONUS FIX: also fixed a `Cannot access 'validated' before initialization` ReferenceError in the ticker branch — line 202 referenced `validated.target1` (outer array being built) instead of `v.target1` (inner const inside the `.map`). This was masked previously because the broken SELECT made `preds` empty. Now that the SELECT works, the bug surfaced and broke the response. Fixed by changing `validated.target1` ? `v.target1`.
  - Test: `curl 'http://localhost:3001/api/predictions?ticker=KCEM&limit=5'` ? `{"source":"local_db_ticker","stats":{"total":1}}` returning KCEM prediction with proper entry/target/stop/risk_reward. Previously returned `{"source":"local_db_ticker_empty","stats":{"total":0}}`.

- **BUG 2 (CRITICAL)** — `/api/crypto/full-analysis` ignores `symbol` param
  - File: `src/app/api/crypto/full-analysis/route.ts`
  - Root cause: route reads `searchParams.get('ticker')` only. When the QA team (and Flutter/mobile clients) send `?symbol=ETH`, the `ticker` param is empty ? defaults to `'BTC'` ? all 9 tested symbols returned identical BTC data.
  - Fix: read both `ticker` and `symbol` query params (prefer `ticker`, fall back to `symbol`).
  - Test: `curl 'http://localhost:3001/api/crypto/full-analysis?symbol=ETH'` ? `{"ticker":"ETH","name":"ethereum"}` (candles=92). `?symbol=SOL` ? `{"ticker":"SOL","name":"solana"}`. `?ticker=ETH` still works (backward compatible).

- **BUG 3 (CRITICAL)** — `computeSupportResistance()` fabricates S/R via `r.low || r.close` fallback
  - File: `src/lib/unified-stock-data.ts` (line 233, function `computeSupportResistance`)
  - Root cause: line 239 `const lows = recent.map((r) => r.low || r.close).filter((v) => v > 0)` — when `r.low` is null (very common per QA bug #11: 92% of stocks have null OHLC rows), it fell back to `r.close` as the "low". Result: support == price, creating 17/60 (28%) illogical S/R.
  - Fix: replaced the `r.low || r.close` fallback with a strict filter — only rows where `low` AND `high` AND `close` are all `typeof === 'number' && > 0` are kept. If fewer than 5 valid rows remain, return `{support: null, resistance: null}` (Rule 27 — null is better than a lie).
  - Note: for stocks where the historical low genuinely equals the current price (e.g. 4347 trading at its 20-day low), support==price is still correct — that's a real market state, not a fabrication. The fix only stops the case where the low was *invented* from `close`.
  - Type check: no new TS errors introduced (only pre-existing errors at lines 378/630 unrelated to my edit).

- **BUG 4 (HIGH)** — `/api/live/scan` ignores `market` param
  - File: `src/app/api/live/scan/route.ts`
  - Root cause: line 36 called `getTopMoversFallback(limit)` without the `market` argument. The fallback function (`src/lib/flutter-sqlite-fallback.ts:169`) already accepts `market?: string` as the 2nd param — it just was never passed. Also, the Python-backend fetch at line 21 didn't forward the market param either.
  - Fix: read `market` from query params, pass it both to the Python backend URL (`?market=TADAWUL`) and to `getTopMoversFallback(limit, market)`. Added `market` field to the response for transparency.
  - Test: `curl 'http://localhost:3001/api/live/scan?market=TADAWUL&limit=5'` ? returns Saudi tickers (9537, 1325, 9655, 9579, 9617 — all `market:TADAWUL`). `?market=EGX` ? returns EGX tickers (TOUR, SPHT, TWSA, LUTSL, CPMEC). Previously all markets returned the same 10 EGX stocks.

- **BUG 5 (HIGH)** — `/api/news-feed` ignores `market` param
  - File: `src/app/api/news-feed/route.ts`
  - Root cause 1: `fetchNewsSignals()` queried `market_news` table — but `news.db` actually has `news_articles` (with a `market_code` column: EGX/TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/GENERAL). The wrong table name caused a silent SQLite error ? returned []. Root cause 2: even when `market` query param was provided (e.g. `EGX`, `TADAWUL`, `US`), the route only checked `isCryptoMode = marketFilter === 'crypto'`. For all other markets it ran the same code path ? identical crypto news returned.
  - Fix: (a) corrected table name to `news_articles`; (b) added a `market?` arg to `fetchNewsSignals` and filter by `market_code`; (c) introduced `isStockMarketMode` branch — for stock markets (EGX/TADAWUL/KSE/QSE/US) skip CoinGecko/fear-greed/global-market fetches entirely (no crypto noise for stock investors); (d) only fetch EGXPilot news for `market=egx` or `market=all`; (e) per-market cache key.
  - Bonus: also fixed the bug where `news_signals` table (in predictions.db) doesn't exist on this install — added a `sqlite_master` existence check before querying, so the silent catch is no longer needed.

  - File: `src/app/api/news-feed/route.ts` (line ~408)
  - Root cause: `error: 'internal_error' || '??? ?? ??? ???????'` — JS `||` short-circuits on the first truthy value, so the Arabic string was dead code. Arabic users always saw English `"internal_error"`.
  - Fix: replaced with `error: '??? ?? ??? ???????'`.

- **BUG 7 (HIGH)** — `marketPulse-proxy.ts` doesn't forward upstream status code
  - File: `src/lib/market-pulse-proxy.ts` (line 34)
  - Root cause: `return NextResponse.json(data)` without the 2nd status arg. When Python backend returns 5xx, NextResponse defaults to HTTP 200 ? clients see a 200 with `success:false`, breaking their error-handling logic.
  - Fix: `return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status })` — forward the upstream status code verbatim.

- **BUG 8 (HIGH)** — All 153 predictions have `holding_days=0`
  - File: `src/app/api/predictions/route.ts`
  - Root cause: `holding_days` column has `INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`. The prediction writer never set it (all 153 rows have 0). Verified at DB level: 148 of those have both `prediction_date` and `outcome_date` present (the other 5 are still pending), so we can compute it on read.
  - Fix: chose "compute on read" (no migration needed — existing rows fixed immediately). Added a SQL `CASE` expression in BOTH SELECT queries (ticker branch + general fallback):
    ```sql
    CASE
      WHEN holding_days > 0 THEN holding_days
      WHEN outcome_date IS NOT NULL AND prediction_date IS NOT NULL
        THEN CAST(julianday(outcome_date) - julianday(prediction_date) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 0
    END AS holding_days
    ```
  - Test: `curl 'http://localhost:3001/api/predictions?ticker=KCEM&limit=5'` ? `KCEM hd=14` (pred=2026-04-01 ? outcome=2026-04-15, 14 days). Verified via direct DB query: KCEM=14, TAO=12, EG23X=28, TMGH=15, 1322=25, 1302=27, ALCN=33, BOURSA=8, ENERGYH=13, etc. — all now reflect actual holding periods instead of 0.

- **BUG 6 (HIGH, screener)** — `/api/finance/screener` returns ONLY TADAWUL
  - File: `src/app/api/finance/screener/route.ts`
  - Root cause: NOT a hardcoded TADAWUL filter — the `ORDER BY ta.market, ta.symbol` clause sorts Arabic market names alphabetically. Since `????????` (Saudi) sorts before `??????`/`???`/`???` in Arabic, the first 50 rows are always TADAWUL. The `?market=eg/sa/kw/qa` filter already worked, but the default (`market=all`) was visually broken.
  - Fix: (a) added long-form market aliases (`egx`, `tadawul`, `kse`, `qse`, `us`) alongside the existing short codes (`eg`, `sa`, `kw`, `qa`); (b) when `market=all`, use a window function `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.market ORDER BY ta.symbol)` and filter `_rn <= ceil(limit/4)` to distribute the limit evenly across the 4 active markets in `data_engine.db`; (c) updated the error message to list all accepted aliases.
